title: MONTE Standard — Barbell Squat

checks.text: Free barbell back squat; high- or low-bar position. Start upright, hips and knees extended, feet planted. No Smith machine, front squat, supportive suit or knee wraps.
Hip crease passes below the top of the knee on the same side. Side-oblique view must show hip and knee throughout; an obscured depth is inconclusive, not a pass.
No bounce off safety supports, double descent, assistance, or loss of control. Belt and non-supportive knee sleeves allowed; record equipment.
Return to stable upright position with hips and knees extended before reracking. Spotter contact during the scored repetition invalidates it.

safety: Do not attempt a dangerous maximum for a rank. Use conservative loads, appropriate safety equipment and competent spotting. Pain or an unclear camera angle is not a reason to repeat a dangerous lift. Ranking is optional.
evidence: Continuous unedited footage showing setup, complete attempt and finish; load markings and total load, date/identity linkage and bodyweight/category attestation must be reviewable. Additional angles may be required. No automated form or identity certification.
visualExamples: Pending qualified review; no fabricated example footage is supplied.
